verdict.rationale: The only benchmark evidence is founder statements on Hacker News: a claim of almost 90% on unnamed standard industry benchmarks, and 87% human-labeled answer accuracy on HotpotQA. None of the first-party docs in the pack publish benchmark results or methodology to back the recall claims. Missing for 10: a published first-party benchmark page or report, results on memory-specific benchmarks such as LongMemEval or LoCoMo, reproducible methodology and code, and independent corroboration of the reported numbers.
